name: MapCompass
intent: A compass-realignment control: a two-tone needle that rotates to reflect the current map `bearing` (staying pointed at north) and, when pressed, calls `onResetNorth` to snap the map back to north. Mirrors the `VerticalZoomTools` UI so it can float over a map or nest (`variant="bare"`) inside a larger vertical toolbar.

lineage.authoredBy: Group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
lineage.confidence: unset — intent taken verbatim from the module's own doc comment; contract not yet enumerated
notes: Was exported from @corensystem/coren-ui with no manifest at all, so it did not exist to the builder, to library-index.json, or to any agent selecting components.
Stub by design: the intent is accurate, the data contract is not yet authored.

props.name: variant
props.description: `default` draws the bordered floating surface; `bare` drops it (to nest inside a larger vertical toolbar).

props.name: bearing
props.description: Current map bearing in degrees (0 = north). The needle counter-rotates so it keeps pointing north.
